Śauri
son of Vallabha, the minister of Yaśaskara of Kāśmira. q. in Spandavivṛti or Spandakārikāvivaraṇa of Rājānaka Rāma, IO. 2525.

Śaurikathā
kāvya. prob. by Vāsudeva. Br. Mus. 247. GD. 1980 (inc.). Granthappura p. 93 (no. 1980; inc.). MT. 1852 (b; inc.). TCD. 1367-B (1st - 6th Āśvāsas). 1443-C. 1555. Tra. Ad. Rep. 1102, 76 (inc.). 1109, 40. Trav. Uni. 4141 (inc.). Trippūṇittura I. 81 (inc.). Triv. Cur. VII. 180.
-C. Vyākhyā. GD. 1981 (inc.). Granthappura p. 93 (no. 1981). (inc.).

Śaurikathā
or ºkathodaya. a yamaka kāvya based on Harivaṃśa. by Vāsudeva Paramaśivayogin (a yamaka poet) son of Ravi, disciple of Bhārataguru, of Viprasattama village. in 6 cantos, describes tenth skandha of Bhāgavata.
See M. Krishnamachariar. HCSL. sns. 65. 369; also K. K. Raja, CKSL. p. 21. 29. 155.
Baroda II. 13703 (c). Deśamaṅgalam 1591. p.. 433-35. MD. 11815. Trav. Uni. TM-44. T-521 (inc.). T-523. C-612 (inc.). 883-A. 969-B (inc.). C-1004-C.(inc.). 1059-A. C-2302-B. C-2445-B (inc.). 4141 (inc.). 10649-C.(inc.). 10688 (inc.). 13367-A (inc.). Trav. [Page165-b] Uni. Sup. 17694-B (inc.). 20984 (inc.). VVRI. I. p. 227 (inc.).

Śaurikīrtana
by Pūntāram Nampūtiri. Trav. Uni. C.. 11-M.

Śauricaritra
yamaka poem in Pkt. composed in Malabar in 1700 C.E. by Śrīkaṇṭha, among four Śrīkaṇṭhas, who flourished under patronage of Zamorin of Calicut, was a member of the Variyar Community. He was a pupil of his uncle Śaṅkara.
See K. K. Raja, CKSL. p.. 110-11; also M. Krishnamachariar, HCSL. sn. 338.
Deśamaṅgalam 1095. 1259. 1338. 1551. GD. [Page166-a. 1982. Granthappura p. 93 (no. 1982). MT. 4321 (inc.). Trav. Uni. L-105-A (inc.). 560 (inc.).

Śaurirāja
preceptor of Varadarāja (a. of Vaṅgīpureśvarakārikāvali, MD. 5359).

Śaurirājastotra
or Śaurirājacaraṇāravindaśaraṇāgatisāra. by Viṣṇu alias Rāmānujadāsabhikṣu. in 3 sns. deals with Aṣṭākṣaramantra. Adyar II. 167b. Adyar D. IV. 3130. Extr. p.. 390-91.
